$comment: How to reach routes that need more than a bare path: a query string, a dynamic segment value, a specific session, or an expected redirect. Routes come from app/**/page.tsx and never from this file, so an entry here can only describe a route, never add or hide one. An entry naming a route that no longer exists fails the gate. A skip must also say what it waits on: an issue number, which expires the skip the moment that issue closes, or permanent true for a standing decision that never expires.
